annotation.title_clean: Proyecto de Ley: Responsabilidad Algorítmica y Promoción de la Robótica, Algoritmos Verdes e Inteligencia Artificial en la República Argentina
annotation.title_en: Bill: Algorithmic Responsibility and Promotion of Robotics, Green Algorithms and Artificial Intelligence in the Argentine Republic
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Maximiliano Ferraro, Honorable Cámara de Diputados de la Nación (Argentina)
annotation.venue: Honorable Cámara de Diputados de la Nación Argentina
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Argentine congressional bill by Deputy Maximiliano Ferraro establishing a general framework for algorithmic responsibility and transparency, based on OECD principles. It creates an AI Advisory Council, a public registry of significant-risk automated systems, voluntary good-practice certifications, and a federal programme promoting AI, robotics and green algorithms.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates an ad honorem AI Advisory Council as enforcement authority issuing non-binding recommendations.
Public registry of significant-risk automated decision systems, including biometric categorisation and social scoring.
Voluntary algorithmic good-practice certification for the private sector, mandatory for the national public sector, with tax benefits.
Authority may request privacy and fundamental-rights impact assessments.
Federal Programme for AI, robotics and automation, including green algorithms and voluntary standards.
